description: Blacks out the rest of the monitor around a windowed game, and strips its title bar and border.
pre_uninstall: if ($tidy.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Game Backdrop could not remove its Start at logon shortcut or task, so it was not uninstalled.' }
Get-Process GameBackdrop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$(Split-Path $dir)\*" } | Wait-Process -Timeout 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
notes: Your game list stays in %APPDATA%\GameBackdrop after an uninstall; delete that folder to remove it too.
